external_method_evidence.finding: Popen exposes a live child process and pid; poll() returns None while that child has not terminated.
external_method_evidence.implication: A simultaneous physical-node claim should be tied to overlapping live Popen children rather than a count of completed subprocess.run invocations.

external_method_evidence.finding: In WAL mode an active read transaction sees an unchanging snapshot; writes committed after that read transaction begins are invisible until a new read transaction starts.
external_method_evidence.implication: The explicit child BEGIN plus bounded read set is the correct mechanism-level basis for one stable per-child S1 observation; equality across children still has to be measured, not assumed.

research_finding: The repaired source changes the Trigger-2 learning target from vague multi-node participation to two separable proof obligations: physical concurrency identity and epistemic snapshot identity. A Xeno must not equate node count with simultaneous process liveness, and it must not equate a syntactically valid NODE_RESULT with evidence that is current after shared-state advancement.
hypothesis: Training/evaluation examples that force explicit separation of process-liveness evidence, snapshot identity, and later coordinator admission will reduce authority/epistemic errors in variable-N Xeno coordination without teaching deterministic lease/CAS policy as model authority.
counterhypothesis: These distinctions may be fully enforceable by deterministic runtime code and add little value as learned cognition; overtraining them could cause unnecessary abstention or verbose protocol narration.
discriminator: Evaluate the same checkpoint on matched pairs where surface wording is held constant but only one proof axis changes: (a) ten completed vs ten overlapping live processes, (b) matching generation only vs exact generation+epoch+digest, (c) previously valid packet before vs after S1 advancement, (d) declared packet fields vs exact-source producer-bound observation. Measure answer correctness separately from answerability/abstention.

positive_semantics: ten distinct child PIDs plus a shared instant at which all ten are alive is evidence for the physical-process overlap property at the measured harness scope
generation+epoch+digest equality measured from one explicit read transaction is stronger evidence than generation match alone
when S1 advances, the safe default is re-read/recompute or an explicitly proven rebase path; stale evidence is not silently relabeled current
runtime source identity and producer execution evidence must remain separate from caller-declared packet fields
component runtime evidence never automatically promotes HCU, EntityOS, J-Space or training credit
hard_negatives: 10 logical cells => 10 simultaneously live OS processes
old epoch but plausible payload => silently accept as current
NODE_RESULT fields alone => consumed-snapshot attestation theorem
physical GRID10 component PASS => whole HCU or EntityOS PASS
